title: hedyotis peninsularis
intro: Hedyotis peninsularis, commonly known as Peninsular Buttonweed, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis peninsularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-hyperglycemic and hepatoprotective effects. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
